title: Warehouse Receiving Authorization Form
subtitle: Warehouse Receiving: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Warehouse Receiving Authorization Form binds inbound appointment, vehicle, seal, handling unit, item, lot, quantity, and putaway status to a named transport decision, commercial or operating limit, effective time, and the receiving / inventory authority's confirmation. The receiving operations coordinator records the requested Warehouse Receiving action and keeps any variance outside the granted authority.
use_case: Use Warehouse Receiving Authorization Form at gate, yard, receiving dock, staging lane, inspection area, and storage location. Reconcile applicable Warehouse Receiving requirements with the load, carrier, rate, claim, equipment, document, or inventory boundary that applies. Capture the receiving / inventory authority's approval, counteroffer, hold, or decline, then reauthorize any change to inbound appointment, vehicle, seal, handling unit, item, lot, quantity, and putaway status.

sections.title: Authorization request and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Warehouse Receiving, identify responsible parties, gate, yard, receiving dock, staging lane, inspection area, and storage location, and the linked inbound appointment, vehicle, seal, handling unit, item, lot, quantity, and putaway status source.

fields.label: Appointment, purchase order, shipment, and receipt
Carrier, driver, vehicle, trailer, and seal
Item, lot, serial, pallet, quantity, and unit

sections.title: Authorization basis and bounded decision
sections.guidance: Capture Warehouse Receiving facts for inbound appointment, vehicle, seal, handling unit, item, lot, quantity, and putaway status; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Warehouse Receiving authorization checks
items: Arrival, gate, dock, and unload timing
Quarantine, hold, cross-dock, or accepted status
Receipt posting, label, staging, and putaway

sections.title: Decision evidence, expiry, and next control
sections.guidance: Resolve open Warehouse Receiving conditions; have receiving operations coordinator assign the next Warehouse Receiving owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Decision limits, holds, and retained evidence
items: Seal, identity, quantity, or condition mismatch
Receipt posting or putaway cannot be reconciled
blocks.guidance: Pause Warehouse Receiving when arrival authority, seal, identity, condition, quantity, system receipt, or storage destination remains unresolved. Retain the available Warehouse Receiving proof and route unresolved inbound appointment, vehicle, seal, handling unit, item, lot, quantity, and putaway status scope to receiving operations coordinator.
